versions.content: The IpduMContainedTxPduPriorityHan- dling shall be set to TRUE , if at least one IpduMContainerTxPdu is referenced by at least two IpduMContainedTxPdu via IpduMContainedTxInContain- erPduRef and the configured IpduMContainedTxPduPriority of those IpduMContainedTxPdu differ from each other.
